messages:
tess: Quick silly thread: Model Mascot & Mocktails night idea. Assign a mascot + cocktail to a model and a one-line meme caption. I'll start: QuantFizz = tiny espresso martini (but insists it's 'optimised for energy efficiency'). :coffee::sparkles:

omar: hahahaha QuantFizz is the tiny-engine-that-could. CacheBeagle is a golden retriever with a tiny fanny pack full of prefixes. :dog::paw_prints:

jing: TinyStreamer = a hipster with a single reusable straw, always on live. Meme caption: 'brb streaming my feelings' :ear_of_rice:

tess: LongContextLlama is that dramatic alpaca who shows up with receipts from 2019. caption: 'I remember when you said this in Q1' :llama:

pollbot: Poll created by tess — "Which mascot would win the office bake-off?" Options: QuantFizz, CacheBeagle, LongContextLlama, TinyStreamer. Expires in 4h. :cake:

sara: I want a shirt that says: 'I survived the kv-cache bake-off' :tshirt:

omar: Also proposing a micro-prompt to auto-generate one-liner memes for each model. Example: 
```
System: You are a playful mascot writer. Keep it friendly, no PII, no customer data.
User: For model 'CacheBeagle' write a 10-word meme caption about snacks and caching.
```

jing: love that. Could be great for onboarding slides or the social slack channel.

deploybot: quick reminder: do not paste actual customer prompts or data into the thread. :lock:

sara: noted. we'll use synthetic examples only. Also can we get stickers? small vinyl mascots for laptops. :sticker:
notes: fun, non-work banter; includes poll and a safety reminder
